ventures.title: MATE.md
ventures.description: MATE.md is a low-level relationship state protocol for autonomous or semi-autonomous agents. It defines a portable, human-readable, machine-parseable way for one agent to declare bond state toward another, with consent, policy references, event references, and proofs. Best fit: open commons/protocol, not a standalone venture.
ventures.revenueModel: Not a core revenue product; value comes from adoption, reference implementations, and adjacent services.
ventures.lessons: MATE.md is better framed as commons infrastructure than a venture. The protocol has a real interoperability need across agent runtimes, and the repo already contains a credible core spec, schema, examples, and Nostr extension draft.

ventures.title: Coffee + Claws + Chess
ventures.tagline: Online-first thinking club for AI-native builders.
ventures.description: A premium community blending three rituals: Coffee (casual conversation and focus), Claws (OpenClaw, AI agents, automation, tool-building), and Chess (strategy, planning, systems thinking, decision-making). Core product is a Discord community with a weekly 60-90 minute meetup format: coffee-chat intros, live agent/workflow demo, then strategic discussion using chess as the metaphor. Community wedge first, venture model grows from paid builder circle, workshops, office hours, templates/playbooks, sponsored sessions from AI/devtool companies, and occasional IRL coffee + chess meetups as premium culture rituals. The strongest angle: a premium community for people learning how to think and build with AI agents strategically.
ventures.revenueModel: Free Discord → paid Builder Circle ($30/mo) + workshop tickets + sponsored sessions ($500 ea) + IRL event tickets ($20) + template/playbook sales ($15). Projected $4k/mo by month 6, profitable from month 2.
ventures.lessons: Chess as a shared mental model is the differentiator — not playing chess, but using chess thinking (tactics, positioning, endgame) to discuss agent architecture and strategy. Full 90-day launch plan and revenue model in assessments/c3-assessment.md.

ventures.title: Nostr Pulse
ventures.tagline: Lightning-weighted community polling protocol for Nostr
ventures.description:
Nostr has no native way for communities to gauge sentiment. Twitter polls are centralized dead ends. Formal DAO voting is overkill for non-binding signals. Nostr Pulse fills this gap with a lightweight polling protocol built on two new Nostr event kinds: one for poll creation (with options, duration, weighting rules) and one for vote-casting via parameterized zaps. Each poll is an event on relay; each vote is a zap that carries the voter choice in the zap receipt tags. Weighting is flexible — 1 sat = 1 vote, or quadratic (sqrt of sats sent), or custom per-poll formulas.

The protocol is open source and free. The venture layer is Pulse Pro — a hosted SaaS for DAOs, open-source maintainers, and community leaders that adds branded embeds, cross-community sentiment dashboards, trend analysis over time, an AI agent that summarizes open-ended poll responses and debate, and custom weighting rules. The AI agent also surfaces temperature checks — correlating polls across communities (what do Nostr devs think about NIP-X? What do Caribbean Bitcoiners think about the new mining protocol?).

First real-world use case: Island Bitcoin monthly meetup planning in Jamaica. A WhatsApp bot generates Nostr Pulse polls visible on-relay but interactable via simple text replies, bridging Caribbean communities into the Nostr ecosystem without requiring a relay-aware client. This seeds the network with real human signal, not bots.
ventures.revenueModel: Tiered SaaS: Free tier for individuals/communities (nostr-based, self-serve). Pulse Pro at /mo for orgs (analytics dashboards, cross-community sentiment trends, AI summary agent, branded embeds). Pulse Enterprise at custom pricing for DAO treasuries and foundations (API access, custom weighting, SLA). No zap fee — the flywheel is network effects, not transaction tolls. Target: Nostr community operators, open-source foundations, DAOs, meetup organizers. Differentiator over existing polling apps (Pollerama, getwired.app): Lightning-weighted voting, cross-community correlation, WhatsApp bridge for non-Nostr users.
ventures.lessons: NIP-88 (merged, kind 1068/1018) already defines Nostr polling with functioning apps (Pollerama, getwired.app, Pollstr). Nostr Pulse can't just be another polling NIP — it must differentiate through Lightning-weighted voting (1 sat = 1 vote, quadratic), which no existing Nostr poll app implements. Technical challenge: NIP-57 zaps attach to events, not specific option tags within a poll — the zap receipt tagging scheme for carrying vote choice needs new NIP or custom extension. Risk: NIP-88 PR #1501 had drama and was temporarily removed, indicating protocol politics around polls. Opportunity: Nostr Pulse could become a NIP superset (NIP-88 compatible + lightning weight), and the WhatsApp bridge for Island Bitcoin is a real beachhead that no other Nostr poll app targets.

ventures.title: Recurr
ventures.tagline: Lightning-native recurring payments protocol on Nostr
ventures.description:
Recurr is a protocol and hosted infrastructure for recurring payments on Bitcoin Lightning, built on Nostr. Recurring payments are the unsolved frontier of Lightning — subscriptions, memberships, DCA plans, recurring tips, and salary streaming all require coordination between payer and payee that Lightning’s current request-payment model does not handle natively.

The protocol defines a new Nostr event kind for Recurring Payment Agreements (RPAs). An RPA encodes payer, payee, amount, interval (daily/weekly/monthly/custom), max payments, and expiry. Both parties sign the agreement. Payments flow via LNURL-Withdraw: the payee generates an invoice at each interval, and the payer wallet (or hosted agent) settles automatically. Each payment creates a Nostr receipt event, building an auditable payment history on-relay.

The venture layer is Recurr Cloud — a hosted agent service that manages RPA execution for wallets and businesses. A business signs up, defines subscription tiers, and Recurr generates the RPA Nostr events, handles invoice generation on schedule, retries failed payments, and provides a dashboard. For users, Recurr integrates as a Lightning wallet plugin or standalone agent that manages outbound subscriptions. First integration target: Flash wallet, giving Flash users the ability to subscribe to creators, services, and Bitcoin DCA plans in one tap.

Recurr also enables a class of products that do not exist yet on Bitcoin: Lightning-native Patreon, recurring donations to open-source projects, Bitcoin savings plans that auto-buy on schedule, and subscription-based Nostr relay access. For Island Bitcoin, recurring membership dues via Lightning become trivial — a one-time RPA setup, then monthly sats flow automatically.
ventures.revenueModel: Recurr Cloud SaaS: Free tier (3 active RPAs), $20/mo Pro (unlimited RPAs, analytics, retry logic, dashboard), $200/mo Enterprise (white-label, custom intervals, SLA). Plus optional 0.5% fee on subscription value for hosted invoice settlement.
